title: Rice flatsedge in paddy rice - Vietnam

Header: Rice flatsedge in paddy rice - Vietnam
Cyperus iria Lác rận, lác mỡ, cú rận, cói gạo

Prevention: Prevention is particularly important as the weed is difficult to control.
Seeds are the main means of spread.
Clean tools and farm machinery after working in an infested area to prevent spread of the weed.
Flooding of rice fields to a depth of 5-10 cm for 10-15 days strongly suppresses the growth of
Rotate crop every season or annually, as applicable, with non-flooded crops such as maize, soybean, and vegetables.
Monitoring: Tufted, annual or perennial sedge (10-70cm) with numerous yellowish-red fibrous roots.
Leaves: basal, linear and flaccid with tapering point (3-8mm wide).
Sheath is reddish or purplish brown.
Inflorescences: umbrella- like head, golden to yellowish- green.
Fruit: shiny, dark brown to black nut with 3 sides (1-1.5cm).
Monitor the fields weekly during the first 30 days after transplanting/sowing.
Take direct control action, once the weed has been found.
Direct Control: Hand weed at an earlier stage of growth to prevent flowering and seed production.
Rotary weeding in transplanted rice during the seedling stage.
250g a.i/ ha) after harrowing and sowing of rice.
600g a.i/ha) after emergence of the weed.
Restrictions: Use of chemical herbicides may lead to the development of herbicide resistance.
When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
U (unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use), WSSA resistance group 14.
